summary: HDFC Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 31, 2026, disclosing that Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan, Managing Director and CEO, informed the Board of his decision not to seek reappointment, despite board persuasion. He will retire on October 26, 2026. The Board appreciated his leadership, including completion of a major merger, and will fast-track successor selection. No financial terms or advisors are mentioned. This is a high-profile leadership transition at a major Indian bank. What to watch: successor announcement and any strategic impact on the bank's operations.
